nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; used as the sole access-control authority in ensure(), delegate(), init(), batchSend() and setTradeAddress().
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked += / -= in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances, mutated with unchecked -= in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting per-address sale operations; incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition().
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition check in ensure().
Private minimum trade value threshold, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Private maximum trade value threshold, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Private maximum number of sales per address, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Privileged address whitelisted in ensure(); writable only by owner through setTradeAddress().
Public total supply, assigned once in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Public constant decimals value (18) used for the supply scaling.
Constant Uniswap V2 Router address whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer() that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist gate; returns true for owner/tradeAddress/pair/UNI/canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition(_from,_value).
Public payable transferFrom() performing allowance bookkeeping and balance mutations with unchecked arithmetic after ensure().
Public payable approve() writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-allowance protection.
Internal view sale-limit validator reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable delegate() that owner-gates and then perfoms an arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address a with caller-supplied calldata b.
Public owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using decimals scaling.
Public payable owner-only batch distribution performing unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance subtraction.
Public owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address computation using a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender, setting owner and granting unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for owner and allowance checks throughout the contract.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() to an arbitrary caller-supplied address, allowing full storage/owner takeover.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (integer underflow class).
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (integer overflow/underflow class).
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (integer overflow class).
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend (integer underflow class).

edges.reason: transfer() immediately delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() requires condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
condition() boolean result is consumed by ensure() to authorize the transfer.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the privileged owner address, creating a whitelist bypass of the sale condition.
ensure() whitelists the owner-settable tradeAddress, bypassing condition().
ensure() treats canSale[_from] as an unconditional whitelist bypass (canSale is never actually written, leaving it defaultValue-only).
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of permitted sales per address.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
msg.sender is used as the spender for the allowance check and deduction in transferFrom().
delegate() gates on require(msg.sender == owner) before performing the delegatecall.
init() gates on require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() gates on require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() gates on require(msg.sender == owner).
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
transferFrom() reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
batchSend() reads and writes balanceOf entries.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
delegate() reaches the low-level delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
User-supplied target address a is used directly as the delegatecall destination.
User-supplied calldata b is executed in this contract's storage context.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath (underflow vector).
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath (overflow vector).
batchSend() performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath (underflow vector).
User-supplied recipient array length feeds the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
User-supplied value feeds the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
